description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 09.05.2016 to 15.05.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and specifically deals with setting new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It rescinds a previous notification and establishes regulatory requirements for currency conversion in customs matters. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it concerns regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments related to customs operations.
